# Draft:Corey Edwards (politician)

Corey Gwilym Edwards is a Welsh politician for Reform UK Wales. He was previously a member of the Welsh Conservatives, and an advisor to David TC Davies.
Career
Edwards held a number of roles as a special advisor to several Conservative government figures under the Liz Truss and Rishi Sunak governments. This included working for the Attorney General and in the Cabinet Office under Minister Michael Ellis. He further served as an advisor for David TC Davies, then the Secretary of State for Wales, from October 2022 to November 2023.
In April 2024, Edwards was appointed as FirstGroup's head of Political Engagement. In January 2026, he led the company's presence at Reform UK's conference, stating that they had ‘got in there early to help shape their transport policy,’ when interviewed there.
In March 2026, Edwards was announced as Reform's lead candidate for the Pen-y-bont Bro Morgannwg constituency. Shortly after, an image was published by Nation.Cymru of Edwards doing a Nazi salute. It was alleged that this image had been known about in Welsh Conservative circles for 6 years, but not released. He received a statement of support from Nigel Farage, who said he "wouldn't approve of it" but would not remove Edwards from the party. Edwards claimed the salute was a reference to Welsh Footballer Wayne Hennessey, while Farage claimed it was a reference to the TV show Fawlty Towers.
